newsitem.title: USA: DeBartolo pulls out of casino on NFL concerns.
newsitem.headline: DeBartolo pulls out of casino on NFL concerns.

text.p: DeBartolo Entertainment Louisiana Gaming Inc said Tuesday that it is withdrawing from the casino portion of a resort it is developing with Hollywood Casino Corp because of National Football League concerns about owners and casinos and a possible conflict of interest over slot machines.

The company is a division of privately-held DeBartolo Entertainment, owner of the San Francisco 49ers. It said it will remain involved in the entertainment and retail component of the project even though it is withdrawing from the casino portion of the Bossier City, La., riverboat project, Cane's Landing, effective immediately.

DeBartolo also owns a racetrack within five miles of the Cane's Landing project, and the spokesman said that slots at both sites would present a conflict of interest, with the company effectively competing against itself.

He added that there had not been any objection from the NFL regarding ownership of the ractrack, because of DeBartolo's "limited" interest in the project. With the casino portion of the Cane's Landing, however, the company would have held a 50 percent stake.
Hollywood Casino, said the company, will request direction from the Louisiana Gaming Control Board to select a new partner for the project.
DeBartolo Entertainment has no corporate affiliation with the Simon DeBartolo Group Inc, a real estate investment trust founded by the same family, the spokesman said.
